run_BriaFiboEditPipeline: run the BriaFiboEditPipeline to edit an image using a JSON prompt with edit_instruction
create_prompt_embeds: create prompt embeddings from text using get_prompt_embeds with the SmolLM3 text encoder
encode_prompt: encode a prompt and optional negative prompt into embeddings with classifier-free guidance support
prepare_latents: prepare random or provided latent tensors and latent image IDs for the diffusion process
prepare_image_latents: encode an input image into latent space using the VAE for image editing
